description: This file defines authentication-related functions for login and registration, utilizing an API request helper to communicate with the server endpoints /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register.

methods.name: login({ email, password })
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request to '/api/auth/login' with email and password to authenticate a user.

methods.name: register({ email, password, name })
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request to '/api/auth/register' with email, password, and name to register a new user.
